verdict.rationale: OpenRouter softens provider rate limits by load-balancing requests across the top providers by default and by falling back to other models when a provider is rate-limited. BYOK gives direct control over provider rate limits, and the key-management API supports minting and rotating keys. However, nothing shows traffic being spread across multiple keys for the same provider, or any request queuing or throttling. Missing for 10: multi-key traffic distribution per provider, request queuing/throttling controls, independent hands-on corroboration of rate-limit smoothing.
